definitions.explanation: Indicating that a product was manufactured in Japan. Often used as a quality marker, since 'Made in Japan' has strong positive connotations both domestically and abroad.

examples.japanese: {日本製|にほんせい}の{車|くるま}。
この{時計|とけい}は{日本製|にほんせい}だ。
examples.english: This watch is made in Japan.

examples.japanese: {日本製|にほんせい}の{家電|かでん}は、{品質|ひんしつ}が{高|たか}いと{評価|ひょうか}されている。
examples.english: Japanese-made home appliances are highly regarded for their quality.

notes:
Compound of {日本|にほん} (Japan) + the suffix {製|せい} (made in/of). The {製|せい} suffix attaches to country or material names to indicate origin or composition: {中国|ちゅうごく}{製|せい} (made in China), {金属|きんぞく}{製|せい} (made of metal).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- As a noun modifier: {日本製|にほんせい}の + noun ({日本製|にほんせい}のカメラ)
- As a predicate: {日本製|にほんせい}だ / です

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日本製|にほんせい}の{車|くるま}: a Japanese-made car
- {日本製|にほんせい}の{家電|かでん}: Japanese-made appliances
- {純|じゅん}{日本製|にほんせい}: purely Japanese-made (all components made in Japan)
